deck_title: Enterprise Webtoon & Manga to 60fps Animated Short-Drama Pipeline: Speech-Bubble OCR Inpainting + 70% 2.5D Multi-Plane Parallax + 30% Controlled FLF2V + Emotional TTS (c_toon = c_0/(1+u), 1.0000x Lock) vs Naive Unstripped Panel I2V

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Enterprise Webtoon-to-Animated-Drama evaluation (segmenting speech balloons and onomatopoeia SFX via YOLO-Manga + Manga-OCR, raycasting balloon tails to attribute speaker IDs, restoring occluded line-art via ControlNet Inpainting, routing 70% dialogue panels to 3-plane 2.5D parallax + 5-vowel mouth sprites [$0.002/shot] and 30% action panels to panel-anchored FLF2V, and compositing 12-language emotional TTS + vector SFX so amortized per-episode cost c_toon(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_toon = 1.0000x across all 17 stages u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive unstripped panel I2V (which floats speech bubbles across faces and melts 2D anime linework, inflating redraw cost by 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stages) and 64-panel multi-plane quadrature.

cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Converting static webtoons, manga chapters, and graphic novels into 9:16 vertical animated short dramas and motion comics across 12 languages
Stripping speech balloons and SFX via Manga-OCR + Line-Art Inpainting before any camera or character animation
Routing 70% dialogue panels to 2.5D 3-plane parallax + 5-vowel mouth sprites ($0.002/shot) and 30% combat climaxes to panel-anchored FLF2V
not_for: Feeding raw comic panels with speech bubbles still attached directly into Image-to-Video models (bubbles float and melt across faces)
Using unconstrained 3D realistic video diffusion on 2D cel-shaded manga panels (destroys original artist linework)
Text-only novels with zero existing comic artwork

dark_box.lead: MIT original code. Synthetic educational scene; local checks reproduced. No production, physics, or neural inference certification.
